影片中的粉丝实际上是该乐队的真正粉丝，他们非常令人信服地将热情传递给了演员。
我原以为会有大量音乐，穿插着薄弱的对话，但我错了。
当悲剧降临主唱Jerry Cosgrove的生活时，乐队成员给予他的支持让我几乎落泪，使我对这个乐队有了全新的欣赏。

paragraphs.text: B Home Fires
paragraphs.translation: B 《家庭之火》

paragraphs.text: I expected a standard,rather dull,story about domestic life,like the director's last two films.Instead,Home Fires had me on the edge of my seat with excitement.It's certainly worth a second viewing.Having said that,although it is apparently a film intended for all ages,many children would find the long discussions of relationship issues boring,and they contributed little or nothing to the film.
paragraphs.translation:
我本以为这会是一个标准、相当枯燥的关于家庭生活的故事，就像导演前两部电影一样。
相反，《家之火》让我紧张得坐立不安，充满兴奋。
这绝对值得再看一遍。
话虽如此，尽管这显然是一部适合所有年龄段的电影，但许多孩子会觉得关于关系问题的冗长讨论很无聊，而这些讨论对电影几乎没有任何贡献。

paragraphs.text: C The Jeffersons
paragraphs.translation: C 《杰斐逊一家》

paragraphs.text: One of the most popular films of the past half century is Mary and Tom,and a remake of it seems unnecessary.Nevertheless,The Jeffersons has some delightful elements,particularly the acting of Yvonne Richards.She really brought the character she played to life,but sadly,neither she nor the other actors could make the script sound natural.
paragraphs.translation:
过去半个世纪最受欢迎的电影之一是《玛丽与汤姆》，对其重拍似乎没有必要。
尽管如此，《杰斐逊一家》仍有一些令人愉悦的元素，尤其是伊冯·理查兹的表演。

paragraphs.text: D Space Challenge 5
paragraphs.translation: D 太空挑战 5

paragraphs.text: This film makes an important ethical point about treating other people with respect,but that is likely to be missed by many teenagers,the target audience, as it assumes familiarity with the world as it was 20 years ago.With change happening so fast these days,many of the references will leave them confused.
paragraphs.translation:
这部电影提出了一个关于尊重他人的重要道德观点，但这一点很可能被目标观众——许多青少年所忽略，因为它假设观众熟悉20年前的世界。

paragraphs.text: E Uplands
paragraphs.translation: E 高地

paragraphs.text: Uplands could have been a delightful film:it has a charming story,witty dialogue,and is visually breathtaking.But the two lead actors are at their best in thrillers,not films like this one.James Petherick,who plays the hero,fails to gain the sympathy of the audience,who should be moved by the ups and downs in his life.
paragraphs.translation:
《高地》本可以成为一部令人愉悦的电影：它有一个迷人的故事、诙谐的对话，而且在视觉上令人叹为观止。
但两位主演在惊悚片中表现最佳，而非这类电影。

paragraphs.text: Sports events in New Zealand
paragraphs.translation: 新西兰的体育赛事

paragraphs.text: A McLeans Island Run
paragraphs.translation: A 麦克莱恩斯岛跑步活动

paragraphs.text: This unique running and cycling event winds its way through the Canterbury countryside and finishes in Orana Park,where your spectators will include lions,tigers,gorillas and giraffes.Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned professional,there's a distance to suit you.Choose from the short,the sprint or the standard distance.You can race to help other people too-if you get some friends or workmates to take part,you'll be in with a chance to win $25,000 to put towards a good cause of your choice.
paragraphs.translation:
这一独特的跑步与骑行赛事蜿蜒穿过坎特伯雷乡村，终点设在奥拉纳公园，届时你的观众将包括狮子、老虎、大猩猩和长颈鹿。
无论你是新手还是经验丰富的专业人士，总有适合你的距离。
你可以从短距离、冲刺距离或标准距离中进行选择。
你还可以通过比赛来帮助他人——如果你邀请一些朋友或同事参与，你将有机会赢得25,000美元，用于支持你选择的慈善事业。

paragraphs.text: B The Pioneer
paragraphs.translation: B 先锋赛

paragraphs.text: The Pioneer is an awe-inspiring seven-day mountain bike race through New Zealand's pristine Southern Alps.It is the first race of its kind to link together over 500 km of farm tracks,cycle trails,double track and single track riding in a very special part of the world where soaring mountain peaks,crystal-clear lakes,and high country await.If you're looking for a mountain bike race to get you inspired,this is it!
paragraphs.translation:
先锋赛是一项令人惊叹的七日山地自行车赛事，穿越新西兰原始南阿尔卑斯山脉。

如果你在寻找一场能激发灵感的山地自行车赛，就是它了！
《先驱者》是一项令人叹为观止的为期七天的山地自行车赛事，穿越新西兰原始的南阿尔卑斯山。
这是首个将超过500公里的农场小径、自行车道、双轨和单轨骑行路线连接起来的赛事，位于一个极为特殊的地方，那里有高耸的山峰、清澈的湖泊和高原地带等待探索。
如果你正在寻找一场能激发灵感的山地自行车比赛，这就是了！

paragraphs.text: C Race Drive Experience
paragraphs.translation: C 竞速驾驶体验

paragraphs.text: If you have ever wanted to experience the extreme thrill of driving a 6000cc race car,then this is definitely for you!You start off your Race Drive Experience by meeting the skilled team of racing drivers at the Motorsport Park Raceway, before being fully kitted out with one of our race suits and safety helmet. 如果你曾经想要体验驾驶6000cc赛车的极致刺激，那么这绝对适合你！

最后，你坐上驾驶座，可以在赛道上进行你自己的高速绕圈驾驶。

paragraphs.text: D Banks Peninsular Walking Festival
paragraphs.translation: D 班克斯半岛徒步节

paragraphs.text: The Banks Peninsula Walking Festival offers guided walks all over the Banks Peninsula.The guides,all volunteers,are local people who love to share their passion for this special place with those from the wider community. Participants are guaranteed an enjoyable experience as they relax,get to know new people and absorb the stories and atmosphere of this fantastic land.

参与者可以放松身心、结识新朋友，并领略这片神奇土地的故事与氛围，从而确保获得愉快的体验。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: What to do if you are made redundant

paragraphs.text: Employees are made redundant when a company has to reduce the workforce because a job or jobs are no longer needed.It has nothing to do with the employees'ability to do their jobs.However,dealing with redundancy can be difficult.Here are some tips on how to cope.
paragraphs.translation:
当公司因某个或多个职位不再需要而不得不裁员时，员工就会被裁撤。
这与员工的工作能力毫无关系。
然而，应对裁员可能是一件困难的事情。
以下是一些应对建议。

paragraphs.text: First of all,don't panic.It's common for people to either rush into a flurry of activity or be frozen by the shock of being suddenly made redundant.The best course of action is to keep calm and draw up a list of all of the things you need to arrange in the months ahead.It's important to find out what your rights are.Obtain a copy of the in-house redundancy policy if there is one and check out your contract for exit terms.
paragraphs.translation:
首先，不要惊慌。
人们通常要么会匆忙陷入一连串的忙乱中，要么会因突然被裁员而震惊得不知所措。
最好的做法是保持冷静，并列出你在未来几个月需要安排的所有事项。
弄清自己的权利很重要。
如果公司内部有裁员政策，获取一份副本，并查看你的合同中关于离职条款的内容。

paragraphs.text: Try to maintain good relations wherever possible with your employer,even if you are angry about the manner of your exit.You will still need a reasonable reference when the time comes to move on,and it may be that your boss can make useful introductions or offer you consultancy work.
paragraphs.translation:
无论何时，尽力与你的雇主保持良好的关系，即使你对离职的方式感到愤怒。
当你到了继续前进的时候，你仍然需要一个合理的推荐信，而且你的老板可能会进行有用的引荐或为你提供咨询工作。

paragraphs.text: Help from a professional outplacement company can make a huge difference to your job search success and reduce the amount of time taken to find your next role.You can purchase this yourself,but there are advantages to having it arranged via your company.
paragraphs.translation:
来自专业再就业服务公司的帮助能极大地提升你求职成功的几率，并缩短找到下一份工作所需的时间。
你可以自行购买这项服务，但通过你所在的公司来安排也有其优势。

paragraphs.text: Don't rush into applying for any or every job that comes up.Take stock of what you have to offer,what you want to do,and carry out in-depth research to find out what employers are actually looking for.Talk to people in your target industry for career advice and information.This information will be invaluable in helping you identify potential employers.
paragraphs.translation:
不要急于申请任何出现的或所有的工作。
评估你所具备的技能、你想要做的事情，并进行深入研究以了解雇主真正在寻找什么。
与目标行业的人士交谈，获取职业建议和信息。
这些信息在帮助你识别潜在雇主方面将是无价的。

paragraphs.text: Assess whether there are any gaps in experience or qualifications that could be a barrier to getting another job and address them.Enrol on some of those courses you have always been too busy to go on:not only will this enhance your skills,it also shows your commitment to continuous professional development.
paragraphs.translation:
评估自己在经验或资历方面是否存在任何可能成为找到另一份工作障碍的缺口，并加以解决。
报名参加一些你一直因太忙而未能参加的课程：这不仅会提升你的技能，还能展示你对持续专业发展的投入。

paragraphs.text: Redundancy enables you to move your career forward in line with your own personal agenda.Although it can be traumatic,many people find that redundancy is actually the incentive they need to take their career in the direction they actually want to go.So think about what you really want,and go for it.
paragraphs.translation:
裁员使你能够按照自己的个人计划推进职业生涯。
尽管这可能令人痛苦，但许多人发现裁员实际上是一种激励，促使他们朝着自己真正想去的方向规划职业。
所以，思考你真正想要什么，然后去追求它。

paragraphs.text: Palvin's Restaurant
paragraphs.translation: 帕尔文餐厅

paragraphs.text: Instructions to new kitchen staff
paragraphs.translation: 给新厨房员工的指示

paragraphs.text: Dress standards at our restaurants are extremely important whichever area you work in.The following information will help ensure that you have a professional appearance every day as you carry out your foodservice duties.
paragraphs.translation:
无论你在哪个区域工作，我们餐厅的着装标准都极为重要。
以下信息将有助于确保你在履行餐饮服务职责时每天保持专业的形象。

paragraphs.text: Palvin's Restaurant chain provides new kitchen staff with their uniforms and you are advised to come to work with a note of your chest,waist and hip measurements to assist in this process.On your first day,you'll be issued with two pairs of trousers,two aprons, two jackets and two hats.Once you're happy that you have the correct size,please take the garments home and add a name tag to each one.Put these inside the garments so that they cannot be seen.
paragraphs.translation:
帕尔文餐厅
Palvin's Restaurant 连锁餐厅为新厨房员工提供制服，建议你上班时带上胸围、腰围和臀围的尺寸记录，以协助完成这一过程。
在第一天，你会领到两条裤子、两条围裙、两件外套和两顶帽子。
一旦你确认尺码合适，请将衣物带回家，并给每件衣物加上姓名标签。
将这些标签放在衣物内侧，以便不可见。

paragraphs.text: Kitchen work can be messy,and it is up to you to make sure that your uniform is kept clean,but you will receive a laundry allowance to help you do this.Towels are available at work,but it's a good idea to bring your own too in case you need it.You can keep this and any other personal items safe in the lockers that are available for use while you're on duty.It's advisable to bring your own small padlock for these.
paragraphs.translation:
厨房工作可能会很脏乱，确保制服保持清洁是你的责任，但你会收到洗衣补贴来帮助你完成此事。
工作场所提供毛巾，但最好也自带毛巾以防不时之需。
你可以将毛巾和其他个人物品安全存放在值班时可用的储物柜中。
建议你自带一个小挂锁来锁这些储物柜。

paragraphs.text: Uniforms should not be worn outside work.You should wear your normal clothes to and from work but make sure they're respectable.For example,hoodies and other similar tops are not acceptable in the kitchens;if it's cold,wear a jacket.When you arrive at work,you can use the changing facilities located next to the lockers to put on your uniform.You can wear your own shoes in the kitchens as long as they're sturdy and enclosed.We strongly recommend rubber soles so that they do not slip on the floor.
paragraphs.translation:
制服不应在工作场所外穿着。
上下班时应穿便装，但要确保着装得体。
例如，连帽衫及其他类似上衣在厨房内是不可接受的；如果天气冷，请穿一件夹克。
到达工作地点后，你可以使用储物柜旁边的更衣设施换上制服。
在厨房里可以穿自己的鞋子，只要鞋子结实且全包即可。
我们强烈推荐橡胶鞋底，以防在地板上打滑。

paragraphs.text: If you incur any injuries that require crutches while you're working for the company, you cannot then take on any tasks that involve standing up.However,if such a situation should occur,we will make every effort to place you in an appropriate area where you can sit down to work so you will not need to take time off.Employees who have smaller injuries,such as hand cuts,need to check with their manager whether they can come to work: you may have to take time off to avoid infection.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你在为该公司工作期间遭受任何需要使用拐杖的伤害，那么你将不能承担任何需要站立的任务。
然而，如果这种情况发生，我们将尽一切努力将你安排在一个合适的区域，让你能够坐着工作，这样你就不需要请假。
受轻伤（例如手部割伤）的员工需要与经理确认是否能够上班：你可能需要请假以避免感染。

parts.title: Passage 3
parts.article_title: The forgotten role of women in medieval arts

paragraphs.text: A

A team of archaeologists recently and unexpectedly revealed direct archaeological evidence of the involvement of medieval women in the production of manuscripts.This challenges the widespread assumptions that men were the sole producers of books throughout the period in European history known as the Middle Ages (600-1500 AD).They did so by identifying particles of blue pigment in the fossilised dental plaque of a medieval woman as lapis lazuli,an extremely valuable stone at the time.The findings are the first of their kind and strongly suggest it will be possible to increase the profile of ancient female artists in the historical and archaeological record by analysing their dirty teeth.
paragraphs.translation:
一个考古学家团队最近意外地发现了直接考古证据，证明中世纪女性参与了手稿的制作。
这挑战了普遍的看法，即在整个被称为中世纪（公元600-1500年）的欧洲历史时期，男性是书籍的唯一制作者。
他们通过鉴定一位中世纪女性化石牙菌斑中的蓝色颜料颗粒为青金石——当时一种极其珍贵的石头——从而得出了这一结论。
这些发现是首次此类成果，并且强烈表明通过分析古代女性艺术家的脏牙齿，有可能提高她们在历史和考古记录中的知名度。
一个考古团队最近意外地发现了直接考古证据，表明中世纪女性参与了手稿的制作。
这一发现挑战了普遍存在的假设，即在整个欧洲历史上的中世纪时期（公元600-1500年），男性是书籍的唯一制作者。
他们通过将一名中世纪女性牙结石中的蓝色颜料颗粒识别为青金石（当时一种极其珍贵的石头），从而证明了这一点。
这些发现是同类中的首个，并强烈表明，通过分析她们脏污的牙齿，有可能在历史和考古记录中提升古代女性艺术家的形象。

paragraphs.text: B

This discovery was made possible by applying technological advances in the field of archaeological science to a little-studied deposit on teeth known as tartar,which is mineralised dental plaque.In most societies today,oral hygiene practices are part of our daily routine,meaning that dental plaque is regularly removed and doesn't have a chance to build up on our teeth.This was not the case in the past.Plaque built up and mineralised over the course of people's lives.This solid deposit has unique archaeological potential.A key characteristic of dental plaque is that while it forms it has the ability to entrap a wide range of microscopic and molecular debris that enters a person's mouth.When dental plaque hardens and becomes tartar,it can entomb these particles and molecules for hundreds or thousands of years-potentially even millions.
paragraphs.translation:
这一发现的实现得益于将考古科学领域的技术进步应用于一种较少被研究的牙齿沉积物——牙结石，即矿化的牙菌斑。
在当今大多数社会中，口腔卫生习惯是我们日常生活的一部分，这意味着牙菌斑会被定期清除，没有机会在牙齿上积累。
过去的情况并非如此。
牙菌斑在人们的一生中逐渐积累并矿化。
这种固体沉积物具有独特的考古学潜力。
牙菌斑的一个关键特征是，在形成过程中，它能够捕获进入人口腔的各种微观和分子碎片。
当牙菌斑硬化变成牙结石时，它可以将这些颗粒和分子封存数百年或数千年——甚至可能长达数百万年。

paragraphs.text: C

The majority of scholarly work conducted on ancient tartar has been centred on what people ate but,besides taking in food,the human mouth is subject to a constant influx of particles of different types directly from the environment. Tree and grass pollen,spores,cotton fibres,medicinal plants and micro-charcoal have all been reported among the finds from this type of dental analysis.Despite such promising evidence,the value of tartar as environmental evidence has not,so far,been much exploited.
paragraphs.translation:
对古代牙结石进行的大多数学术研究都集中于人们的饮食内容，但除了摄入食物外，人类口腔还持续受到来自环境中各种类型颗粒的直接涌入。
树木和草的花粉、孢子、棉纤维、药用植物以及微炭屑都在这种牙齿分析的发现中被报道过。
尽管有如此有前景的证据，但迄今为止，牙结石作为环境证据的价值尚未得到充分发掘。

paragraphs.text: D

The team analysed the skeletal remains of a female individual,known as B78,who lived in the 11th-12th century.She was buried in the grounds of a former women's monastery in Dalheim,Germany,that is in ruins today but was occupied by various religious groups for around a thousand years.They found well over 100 bright blue particles,in the form of small crystals and individual flecks,scattered throughout the tartar which was still preserved on her teeth. Her skeletal remains had not indicated anything particular about her life, besides a general indication that she probably did not do any hard labour.The blue particles were unlike any other discovery -firstly because of their colour, and secondly because of their sheer number.
paragraphs.translation:
该团队分析了生活在11至12世纪、被称为B78的女性个体的骨骼遗骸。
她被埋葬在德国达尔海姆一座前女子修道院的土地上，该修道院如今已成废墟，但曾被不同宗教群体占据约一千年。
他们发现了超过100个亮蓝色颗粒，呈小晶体和零星斑点状，散布在其牙齿上仍保存的牙结石中。
她的骨骼遗骸并未透露出其生活的任何特别信息，除了一般的迹象表明她可能没有从事过重体力劳动。
这些蓝色颗粒与任何其他发现都不同——首先是因为它们的颜色，其次是因为它们的数量庞大。

她被埋葬在德国达尔海姆一座前女子修道院的场地内，该修道院如今已成废墟，但曾被多个宗教团体占据约一千年。
他们发现了远超过100个亮蓝色颗粒，以小晶体和独立斑点的形式散布在仍保留在她牙齿上的牙结石中。
除了大致表明她可能未从事任何重体力劳动外，她的骨骼遗骸并未揭示其生活的任何特别信息。
这些蓝色颗粒与任何其他发现都不同——首先是因其颜色，其次是因为其数量之多。

paragraphs.text: E

To be sure about the nature of the particles of bright blue powder trapped in the woman's tartar,a range of microscopy techniques were used.All techniques provided the same results:the blue specks were lazurite,the blue portion of the lapis lazuli stone,a substance more precious than gold in Medieval Europe.Afghanistan was the only source of the stone at the time, and the preparation of the pigment took great skill.
paragraphs.translation:
为了确认困在该女性牙结石中亮蓝色粉末颗粒的性质，研究人员使用了一系列显微镜技术。
所有技术都提供了相同的结果：这些蓝色斑点是天青石，即青金石的蓝色部分，在中世纪欧洲这是一种比黄金更珍贵的物质。
当时阿富汗是该石料的唯一来源，而且制备这种颜料需要高超的技艺。
为了确定这位女性牙结石中明亮蓝色粉末颗粒的性质，研究人员采用了一系列显微技术。
所有技术都得出了相同的结果：这些蓝色微粒是青金石中的蓝色部分——青金岩，在中世纪欧洲，这种物质比黄金还要珍贵。
当时，阿富汗是该石料的唯一产地，而制备这种颜料也需要高超的技艺。

paragraphs.text: F

So how did particles of this precious material end up deposited on this woman's teeth?A variety of reasons were possible,from painting to accidental ingestion during pigment preparation,or even the consumption of the powder as a medicine.But the way in which the blue particles were found in her tartar-single flecks in different areas-pointed to repeated exposure, not a single intake.And creating a vivid blue pigment from lapis lazuli required an Arabic method of oil flotation that did not appear in European artists'manuals until after the 15th century.This all suggests that it's more likely that this ultramarine pigment was brought into the region as a finished product for use by artists.
paragraphs.translation:
那么，这种珍贵材料的颗粒是如何最终沉积在这位女性的牙齿上的呢？
有多种可能的原因，从绘画到颜料制备过程中的意外摄入，甚至是将这种粉末作为药物食用。
但蓝色颗粒在她的牙垢中被发现的方式——不同区域中的单个斑点——指向的是反复接触，而非一次性摄入。
而且，从青金石中提取鲜艳的蓝色颜料需要一种阿拉伯的油浮选方法，这种方法直到15世纪之后才出现在欧洲艺术家的手册中。
所有这些都表明，这种群青颜料更有可能是作为成品被带入该地区，供艺术家使用。
可能的原因多种多样，从绘画到在颜料制备过程中意外摄入，甚至是将这种粉末作为药物服用。
但是，在她的牙结石中发现蓝色颗粒的方式——不同区域的单个斑点——表明是反复接触，而非一次性摄入。
而且，用青金石制成鲜艳的蓝色颜料需要一种阿拉伯的油浮选方法，这种方法直到15世纪后才出现在欧洲艺术家的手册中。
所有这些都表明，这种群青颜料更可能是作为成品被带到该地区供艺术家使用的。

paragraphs.text: G

The most likely explanation,then,is that this was an artist who repeatedly used her lips to make a fine point on the end of her brush in order to paint intricate detail on manuscripts.This finding suggests that women were more involved in the production of books throughout the Middle Ages than tends to be thought.Before the 12th century fewer than one per cent of the books that still remain can be traced to the work of women.Additionally, artists are largely invisible in both the historic and archaeological records as they rarely signed their work before the 15th century and,until now,there have been no known skeletal markers directly associated with producing art.The work strongly points to the possibility of using microscopic particles entombed in ancient tartar to track the artists of ancient times.It also suggests that it may be possible to track other 'dusty'crafts using this method and thereby reveal the invisible workforce behind many forms of art.
paragraphs.translation:
那么，最有可能的解释是，这是一位艺术家，她反复用嘴唇将画笔末端弄尖，以便在手稿上绘制复杂的细节。
这一发现表明，在整个中世纪，女性参与书籍制作的程度比人们通常认为的要高。
在12世纪之前，现存书籍中只有不到1%可以追溯到女性的作品。
此外，艺术家在历史和考古记录中基本上是不可见的，因为他们在15世纪之前很少在他们的作品上署名，而且到目前为止，还没有已知的与艺术创作直接相关的骨骼标记。
